info.name: Google Chrome Management App Details Reports API

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

params.name: orgUnitId
params.description: The organizational unit ID. If omitted, returns data for all org units.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter string for narrowing results. Supports filtering by version, channel, platform, and last active date.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for pagination.

items.docs: Generates a count report of Chrome browser versions installed across all managed browsers. Useful for tracking update adoption and identifying outdated browser installations.

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

params.name: orgUnitId
params.description: The organizational unit ID.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter string. Supports filtering by app name, app ID, app type, install type, and permissions.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Field to sort results by. Supported fields: app_name, install_type, machine_count, and permission_count.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for pagination.

items.docs: Generates a report of installed apps and extensions across all managed browsers and devices. Provides counts and details for each app or extension including version, install type, and number of installations.

info.name: Find devices with a specific app installed

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

params.name: appId
params.description: The app ID to search for.

params.name: appType
params.description: Type of the app. Values include EXTENSION, APP, THEME, HOSTED_APP.

params.name: orgUnitId
params.description: The organizational unit ID.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter string for narrowing results.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Field to sort results by.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for pagination.

items.docs: Generates a report listing all managed browsers and devices that have a specified app or extension installed. Useful for tracking distribution and compliance of specific applications.

info.name: Count ChromeOS devices reaching auto-update expiration

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

params.name: orgUnitId
params.description: The organizational unit ID.

params.name: minAueDate
params.description: Minimum auto-update expiration date filter (inclusive) in yyyy-mm-dd format.

params.name: maxAueDate
params.description: Maximum auto-update expiration date filter (inclusive) in yyyy-mm-dd format.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for pagination.

items.docs: Generates a report counting ChromeOS devices grouped by their auto-update expiration date. Helps administrators plan for hardware refresh cycles and identify devices that will lose security update support.

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

params.name: orgUnitId
params.description: The organizational unit ID.

items.docs: Generates a report counting managed Chrome browsers that need administrator attention. Categories include browsers with pending updates, browsers recently not active, browsers with no recent policy sync, and browsers that recently enrolled.

info.name: Count ChromeOS devices needing OS update

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

params.name: orgUnitId
params.description: The organizational unit ID.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for pagination.

items.docs: Generates a report counting ChromeOS devices that need an operating system update, grouped by OS version and update status.

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

params.name: orgUnitId
params.description: The organizational unit ID.

params.name: readMask
params.description: Fields to include in the response. Options include cpuReports, memoryReports, modelReports, storageReports.

items.docs: Generates a report counting ChromeOS devices grouped by hardware specifications such as model, CPU, and storage capacity. Provides a fleet-level view of hardware diversity.
